input: Hello students
Welcome to the Bridge Engineering class at Kunming University of Science and Technology.
Based on the previous learning
People have gained some understanding of the composition and classification of bridges.
Starting today, we will begin learning about the detailed construction of bridges.
First, there's the layout and construction of the bridge deck.
Bridge deck construction typically includes bridge deck pavement.
Waterproofing and Drainage System
Bridge deck expansion joints
sidewalk
Edge Stone
railing
Guardrails and lighting poles, etc.
The bridge deck structure is mostly exposed.
Direct contact with the outside world
It plays a protective role for the main structure of the bridge.
It also plays an important role in driving safety and the aesthetics of bridges.
Next, we will study bridge deck paving in detail.
Waterproofing and Drainage System
Bridge deck expansion joints
sidewalk
Specific construction of lampposts and safety protection measures
First is the bridge deck paving.
Bridge deck paving is also known as roadway paving.
or bridge deck protective layer
It is the part that is directly affected by the wheels or pedestrians.
Its main function is to protect the main structure of the bridge.
Including preventing vehicle tires from directly wearing down the driveway slab.
To prevent the main beam from being eroded by rainwater.
It can disperse concentrated loads on vehicle wheels, etc.
And to meet the normal functional requirements of the bridge.
Layout and aesthetic requirements
therefore
Bridge deck paving is required to be rutting resistant.
Driving comfort
Anti-slip and wear-resistant
Low-temperature cracking
impermeable
Good stiffness and other properties
Currently, two common methods are used for bridge deck paving.
One type is cement concrete or asphalt concrete pavement with a waterproof layer.
This type of paving is mainly used where waterproofing requirements are high.
Or on bridges where the bridge deck is located in the tension zone of the structure and cracks may occur.
Flexible adhesive or coating waterproofing layers are often used.
The waterproof layer is installed between the cast-in-place monolithic concrete and the asphalt concrete pavement on the bridge deck.
The second category is waterproof concrete paving.
For bridges located in non-freezing areas
A waterproof concrete layer of at least 80mm thickness can be laid on the bridge deck as a pavement layer.
The grade of waterproof concrete is generally not lower than that of bridge deck concrete.
Generally, no additional surface layer is required on top of it.
However, in order to extend the service life of the bridge deck
It is advisable to lay a 20-30mm thick layer on top.
Asphalt surface treatment as a repairable wearing layer
According to the General Specification
The concrete bridge deck pavement must have sufficient density.
The thickness should not be less than 80mm
The concrete strength grade should not be lower than C40.
Steel mesh should be installed inside the cement concrete bridge deck pavement.
The diameter of the reinforcing bar shall not be less than 8mm
Spacing no more than 100mm
Cement concrete bridge deck pavement should meet the following requirements
Relevant provisions of the "Specifications for Design of Cement Concrete Pavement of Highway" (JTG D40-2011)
Asphalt concrete bridge deck paving should meet the following requirements
Relevant provisions of the "Specifications for Design of Asphalt Pavement of Highway" (JTG D50-2017)
Next, we will learn about bridge deck waterproofing and drainage systems.
The main function of the bridge deck waterproofing and drainage system is
To prevent water infiltration from affecting the structural durability of the bridge
Ensure smooth traffic flow on the bridge.
Safety
Waterproofing of the bridge deck is mainly achieved by installing a waterproof layer.
The drainage system mainly consists of the longitudinal and transverse slopes of the bridge deck.
Composed of a certain number of drainage pipes and drain pipes, etc.
The bridge deck drainage system should be compatible with the bridge structure and the drainage conditions beneath it.
The drainage system of large and extra-large bridges should be coordinated with the bridge deck pavement design.
When the longitudinal slope of the bridge deck is less than 0.5%
Longitudinal drainage trenches should be installed along the lower edge of the bridge deck pavement.
Bridge deck drainage should meet the requirements
Relevant provisions of the "Specifications for Highway Drainage Design" (JTG/T D33-2012)
The function of the waterproof layer is to prevent rainwater from seeping through the paving layer.
Collected and discharged into the drainage system (drain pipe)
The waterproof layer of the bridge deck is placed under the bridge deck pavement layer.
current
The following two types of waterproofing layers are commonly used in bridges.
(1) Apply waterproof material
(2) Laying asphalt or modified asphalt waterproof membrane
The bridge deck should have sufficient longitudinal spacing.
Lateral slope
So that rainwater can be drained quickly
Prevent or reduce rainwater penetration into the pavement layer
This protects the roadway panels.
Extend the service life of bridges
The transverse drainage slope of the bridge deck should be consistent with the transverse slope of the road surface.
When a sidewalk is provided
Sidewalks should have a cross slope of 0.5% to 1.5% towards the roadway.
The road surface of the driving lane generally adopts a parabolic cross slope.
The sidewalks are straight.
Bridge deck cross slopes typically come in the following four configurations.
(1) To save paving materials and reduce dead load
The top of the pier can be made inclined.
The cross slope is set directly on the top of the pier.
This causes the bridge superstructure to tilt in both directions.
at this time
The pavement layer is made of uniform thickness across the entire width of the bridge.

(2) For bridges with narrow widths
It can be passed directly above the main beam.
The thickness of the cast-in-place monolithic concrete is used to achieve the cross slope setting.

(3) For prefabricated bridges located on the transition curve section of the route
The inclination of the pier cannot fully meet the requirements for cross slope setting.
The height of the pad stone on the top surface of the pier cap needs to be adjusted to achieve the cross slope setting.
As shown in Figure (c)
(4) For wide cast-in-place bridges
The driveway slabs can be set according to the direction of the cross slope.

Drainage pipes commonly used on beam bridges should ideally be installed at the edge of the bridge deck's driving lanes.
They can be arranged symmetrically on both sides of the driving lane.
They can also be arranged in an alternating pattern.
Drain pipes can also be installed under sidewalks.
Water on the bridge deck flows into the drainage holes through inlets located on the sides of the curbs or sidewalk components.
For urban bridges
Or a bridge crosses the highway
railway
Navigable rivers and other rivers or reservoirs with environmental protection requirements
To ensure traffic flow under the bridge
The need for pedestrian safety and environmental protection
A closed drainage system should be installed, similar to that used in buildings.
Rainwater flowing into the drainpipe is collected into the longitudinal drainpipe or drainage ditch.
And through the vertical drainage pipes located at the pier.

桥梁伸缩缝
为保证在气温变化
混凝土收缩与徐变以及荷载作用等因素影响下
桥跨结构能够按静力图式自由地变形
并保证车辆平稳通过
应在两相邻梁端之间
梁端与桥台背墙之间设置伸缩缝装置
桥梁伸缩装置直接暴露在大气中
承受车辆
人群荷载的反复作用
很小的缺陷和不足就会引起跳车等不良现象
从而使其承受很大的冲击
甚至影响到桥梁结构本身和通行者的安全
是桥梁结构中最易损坏又较难修缮的部位
那么对伸缩缝有哪些要求呢
（1）能够满足桥梁自由伸缩的要求
保证有足够的伸缩量
（2）伸缩缝装置牢固可靠
与桥梁结构连为整体
抗冲击
经久耐用
（3）车辆行驶过程应平顺
无突跳和噪声
（4）具有能够安全防水和排水的构造
有效防止雨水渗入
（5）能有效防止垃圾渗入阻塞
（6）构造简单
施工
安装方便
且养护
护理与更换方便
（7）价廉
伸缩缝的类型有以下几种形式：
对接式
剪切式
钢制支承式
模数支承式
无缝式TST弹性装置
下面介绍两种特殊的伸缩缝形式
一种是桥面连续
在多跨简支梁桥中
为了减少伸缩缝数量
使得行车更为顺畅
可将2～7跨一联做成桥面连续构造
在每一联两端设置伸缩缝
但主梁受力还是简支
桥面连续特指桥面混凝土铺装施工中
在墩顶铺装加强段
免去两跨简支桥之间安装伸缩缝的麻烦
桥面连续实际就是桥面铺装的一部分
第二种是无缝式桥梁
指通过采用整体式墩帽
连续的桥跨
活载作用下结构连续等方式取消了桥墩处接缝的桥梁结构
主要分为以下四种
①柔性拱桥
②具有滑动接缝的无缝桥梁结构
③无台式桥梁结构
④整体式桥台结构
最后是人行道
灯柱及安全措施
城市桥梁一般均应设置人行道
高速公路上的桥梁不宜设人行道
一二三四级公路上桥梁的桥上人行道的设置
应根据需要而定
人行道的宽度由行人的交通量决定
其宽度1.0m
当宽度大于1.0m时
按0.5m的倍数增加
安全带的构造跟人行道类似
只是比人行道窄
随着社会经济的发展和人们安全意识的提高
安全带逐渐被护栏取代
栏杆是桥上的一种安全防护设施
要求既要坚固耐用
又要经济美观
人行道或安全带外侧的栏杆高度不应小于1.10m
栏杆构件间的最大净间距不得大于14cm
且不宜采用横线条栏杆
自行车道栏杆高度不应小于1.40m
伸缩缝处的栏杆要能自由变形
在城市桥上及城郊行人和车辆较多的公路桥上
均应设置照明设施
一般采用柱灯在桥面上照明
根据人行道宽度及桥面照度要求
灯杆宜设置在人行道外侧栏杆处
当人行道较宽时
灯杆可设置在人行道内侧或分隔带中
杆座边缘距车行道路面的净距不应小于 0.25m
照明用灯一般高出车道5m左右
各等级公路桥梁必须设置路侧护栏
高速公路
一级公路桥梁须设置中央分隔带护栏
护栏的主要作用在于封闭沿线两侧
不使人畜与非机动车辆闯入公路
诱导视线
起到一些轮廓标的作用
使车辆尽量在路幅之内行驶
并给驾驶员以安全感
同时还具有吸收碰撞能量
迫使失控车辆改变方向并使其恢复到原有行驶方向
防止其越出桥外或跌落桥下的作用
桥梁护栏按防护性能分为刚性护栏
半刚性护栏和柔性护栏
左图中的混凝土护栏就属于刚性护栏
车辆碰撞后基本不变形
波形梁护栏是半刚性护栏的主要代表形式
车辆碰撞后有一定的变形
又具有一定强度和刚度
